decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the established portfolio and has kept its own dedicated page in both years, a visible and continuing commitment that fits the announced direction toward automated inline finishing, so management will persist with it.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer, has a publicly cited customer installation that combines creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, and is still mentioned in 2024, so management sees it as a justified, modular part of its automation strategy worth keeping despite its lower prominence.
